speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
text: asked the Minister for Health (a) whether the Ministry has conducted comparative assessments of similar medical procedures across different countries to understand the medical cost variations; (b) whether the Ministry can provide details on the factors contributing to higher medical costs in Singapore, particularly the role played by our healthcare insurance system; and (c) whether the Government will consider conducting bi-annual reviews of all healthcare charges to ensure they are fair and affordable.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: While one treatment may be less costly in a foreign country compared to Singapore, there may be other treatments where Singapore is more affordable than the same foreign country.
